name: Leslie Roseblade
source:
Likes: Helping people and fashion
Dislikes: Lazy people
Hobby: Shopping
Skill: Archery

"I vow to protect you and the forest"

Elias: Leslie is one of the most reliable senior students of mine.
He is the master archer and uses the bow to cast magic.
It is very unique, isn't it?
He is from the House of Roseblade, which serves as the Guardian of the Forest for generations.
Chica is his familiar, however...
Their relationship is very unique, I would say...

[Official in-game description]
